SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT
Station Foreign Affairs Section File No.
（批：422）
Date 3 January 28th. 1944.

SUBJECT: Re-Registration of local Residents - IRISH.

With the recent announcement in local newspaper of a re-registration of local residents to be made in the near future, a verbal request was made by the Secretary of the Eire Resident's Association on behalf of several of its members, as follows.

When the Eire Resident Association was formed in November, 1942, under the auspices of the Japanese Authorities, several members (9 in number) possessed British Passports, as there were no Irish Consular Authorities at Shanghai and the British Consulate were protecting Irish interests here. These persons therefore received Resident's Cards with a Red Band (Enemy national) when registering with the Police Authorities. On the recognition the Association and its members, who were also exempt from many National Civil Assembly Centers, these persons made several requests to have these Residents' Cards changed to ones of Blue Bands (Neutral) however, without results. With the above announcement appearance, the Association decided to make a further attempt and thus requested the Police for the necessary change.

This request was forwarded to the Officer i/c C.D.I. Matsushita, of the Foreign Propaganda Office, with copies of the attached list and memorandum handed over to him for disposal. For information it should be noted that the 3 members (Marked X) are in possession of Residents' Cards with a Blue Band (Neutral).

（左侧手写批注：）
Resident Certificate can be changed only 3 members who have Irish passport.
Hey
Noted
27/1/44
（签名）

（右下角签名：）
G.A.

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
报告
分局 外事股 档案号
（批：422）
日期 1944年1月3日，第28号。

主题：当地居民重新登记——爱尔兰人。

鉴于当地报纸近日宣布将于近期对当地居民进行重新登记，爱尔兰居民协会秘书代表其部分成员提出口头请求，内容如下。

爱尔兰居民协会于1942年11月在日本当局的主持下成立时，有几名成员（共9人）持有英国护照，因为当时上海没有爱尔兰领事机构，且英国领事馆在此地保护爱尔兰人的利益。因此，这些人在向警察当局登记时，领取了带有红色条纹的居民证（敌国国民）。在该协会及其成员获得认可后，他们也被免除进入敌国国民民事集合中心，这些人曾多次请求将这些居民证更换为带有蓝色条纹的证件（中立国），但未获结果。随着上述公告的发布，协会决定再次尝试，因此向警方请求进行必要的变更。

此请求已转交至对外保甲办公室负责人松田（Matsushita）首席侦探督察（C.D.I.），并附上所附名单和备忘录的副本供其处理。需注意的是，其中有3名成员（标有X者）持有带有蓝色条纹的居民证（中立国）。

（左侧手写批注：）
仅持有爱尔兰护照的3名成员可更换居住证。
Hey
知悉
1944年1月27日
（签名）

（右下角签名：）
G.A.
